Can Nvidia Thrive Without Jensen Huang?

The company’s prospects depends on whether its board is able to avoid a series of common pitfalls.

By

Nvidia shares plunged when Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and board member on Nov. 12, falling as much as 14% before closing down 4.3%. Alongside his departure, the board named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO and Harvey Jones Nvidia’s first-ever board chairman.

Until Mr. Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy came to light, he was the undisputed leader of the global economy’s most influential company. Can Nvidia survive his exit? The answer—and perhaps the future of the American economy—will depend on how the board handles the next few months.
